rhymes_hint: AI/agent app icons with violet->blue gradient glass blobs on a light ground; Big-Sur/Liquid-Glass dev-tool icons that inlay a mono glyph into a glass object; cloud-motif + CLI-glyph terminal/agent icons. Style family: glass-object-on-light-ground, indigo AI gradient.
notes: Source icon is a 204x204 webp resized web render, NOT the 1024 master — all px/positional reads (estimated), hex sampled at low res. Era read as liquid-glass but transitional: the glass translucency/specular appear BAKED into a gradient object rather than proven Icon Composer light/dark/clear/tinted layers (can't confirm variants from one static webp); could equally be Big-Sur-gradient-with-baked-specular. HIG note: Apple says NOT to bake specular/gradient — this icon does, common for shipped-look icons. Cover art (blue-violet wispy petal wallpaper, white geometric-sans 'Codex' wordmark) coheres tightly with the icon ramp — strong icon<->brand palette coherence. Mild contrast dilution where the chevron's upper arm crosses the lighter lavender crown (white-on-lavender dips below the deep-blue contrast). Squircle corners are pre-masked in the webp, so mask discipline (#1) is inferred as clean rather than measured.
